statements.t: With nine months behind us, we are reaffirming the midpoint and are narrowing the range of our 2026 guidance.
We are also introducing our 2027 guidance that reflects strong PJM fundamentals and a full year of contributions from our recently acquired assets,” said Talen Chief Executive Officer Mac McFarland.

We have now repurchased more than one third of the shares outstanding at emergence.” He continued, “Growing demand across PJM strengthens the outlook for our fleet and supports our focus on increasing Adjusted Free Cash Flow per share over the coming years.”

Upon completion of the ASR program at current prices, we will have repurchased approximately 19.5 million shares of TEC common stock for a total of approximately $4.0 billion since the start of 2024, with $1.5 billion remaining under our SRP through year end 2028.
